style.summary: Match the app's existing exercise diagrams, which are flat vector figures drawn in code (src/components/ExerciseDiagram.tsx), not photographs. Square canvas, solid background #F5F8FE, no text and no watermark. A simple geometric adult: rounded thick limbs, no facial features, navy hair cap #25334B, skin #DBAF91, cobalt shirt #3F80EA, navy pants #25334B. A soft ground ellipse #DCE6F7. Sitting figures include a simple chair in #91A5C5. Lying figures are supine, head toward the left, on a thin mat line. One cobalt dashed arrow #3F80EA with a small arrowhead shows the movement. Static pose only: no photo, 3D, anime, or gradients.
style.note: Until illustration.png exists, ExerciseDiagram draws the vector figure. After the PNG is added, run npm run content:build so the image is statically required.
